name: Schlage Encode (US)

radios.note: Allegion says the Encode (BE489) has Bluetooth and Wi-Fi for pairing with the Schlage Home app, and no Z-Wave.

matter.note: No Schlage or Allegion page found says either way for the non-Plus Encode. Allegion says the Encode Plus does not support Matter; that article does not cover this model.

apple_home.note: Allegion says the Encode (BE489) does not support Apple HomeKit and cannot be upgraded to it; it points to the Encode Plus (BE499) instead.

google_home.note: Through the Schlage Home app and Google Assistant. Schlage says Encode locks need no hub or adapter.

alexa.note: Schlage Home skill for Alexa. Amazon's developer blog covers Works With Alexa certification for Schlage's Encode locks.

smartthings.note: Schlage's pages seen list Alexa and Google but not SmartThings. Absence from the list is not a statement that it will not work.

home_assistant.note: Official Schlage integration; the docs list the Encode Smart WiFi Deadbolt as tested. It uses Schlage's cloud API.

hubRequired.note: Built-in Wi-Fi; Schlage says Encode locks need no hub or adapter.

localControl.note: Home Assistant control goes through Schlage's cloud; no source states what works with the internet down.

lockFit.note: Schlage sells it as the Encode Smart WiFi Deadbolt, a complete replacement deadbolt.

keypad.note: Touchscreen keypad on the lock; Allegion has a BE489 keypad troubleshooting article.

power.note: Allegion rates Encode battery life at about 6 months on alkaline AA cells but no official page we found gives the count; retailers list four AA, included.

summary: The Schlage Encode is a US smart deadbolt with a touchscreen keypad and built-in Wi-Fi, so no hub is needed. It works with Alexa and Google Assistant through the Schlage Home app, and Home Assistant has an official integration. It is the non-Plus model: Allegion says it has no Apple HomeKit support and cannot be upgraded, so Apple Home buyers need the Encode Plus.
caveats: No Apple Home support; Schlage's Apple Home Key lock is the Encode Plus (BE499).
Matter and SmartThings support are not confirmed.
The Home Assistant integration goes through Schlage's cloud.
Allegion expects about 6 months of battery life; weak Wi-Fi shortens it.
